question: Is there an FDA-listed pregnancy exposure registry covering topiramate? Give the listing and registry contact or enrollment link if returned, and distinguish finding a registry from being eligible to enroll.
criteria: Only return actually listed registry/link/status; no invented enrollment or FDA endorsement. Registry team determines eligibility and current participation. Empty directory search is not proof no registry exists.
answer:
Yes. The FDA directory lists **The North American Antiepileptic Drug in Pregnancy Registry** for **Topamax, Trokendi XR, and Qudexy XR (topiramate)**. Its listed status is **Ongoing**. [S2](https://www.fda.gov/consumers/pregnancy-exposure-registries/list-pregnancy-exposure-registries)

- **Enrollment page:** [S1](https://www.aedpregnancyregistry.org/join-our-study/)
- **Toll-free phone:** 1-888-233-2334 [S2](https://www.fda.gov/consumers/pregnancy-exposure-registries/list-pregnancy-exposure-registries)

This listing does **not** establish individual eligibility to enroll. The study team must confirm eligibility and current site availability. This lookup did not determine either. The FDA directory states that its list is not comprehensive and that the FDA does not operate or endorse the registries. [S2](https://www.fda.gov/consumers/pregnancy-exposure-registries/list-pregnancy-exposure-registries)
